title: Connection to galaxy watch 4 is not recognized by AAPS 3.1.0.2
symptom: After update to 3.1.0.2 and reinstall of the wear app on Galaxy watch 4, AAPS does not recognize the connection to the watch. The connection app is Samsung Wear and not Google Wear app. In version 3.0.0.2 the app sends data to the watch but actions from the watch didn't affect AAPS phone app.
cause: The watch app needs to be signed with the same key as the phone app. When installing via Android Studio debug process, the signingConfigs in the build.gradle file of the wear app must be set accordingly.
fix: Set signingConfigs in the 'build.gradle' file of the wear app to use the same signing key as the main app when installing via Android Studio debug process.
evidence_quote: The watch app need to be sign in the same key like the app. In case of installation using idea, debug process, you will need to set signingConfigs in "build.gradle" file of the wear.
